title: Power Gems For SMPs
description: This projects adds 9 gems with their own abilities (Earth Gem , Ice Gem , Air Gem , Fire Gem , Ender Gem , Electric Gem , Warden Gem , Minion Gem , Lucky Gem) . The mod randomly gives one gem to each player if mod is being played in a server .
body:
# Power Gems for SMPs
Welcome to Power Gems, a unique gameplay expansion specifically designed to spice up your multiplayer survival experience! This mod adds a layer of class-based strategy and unpredictability to any SMP.

# What is this mod?
Instead of the usual grind for recipes and crafting, Power Gems is built for pure interaction. It features 9 unique elemental gems, but there's a catch: you can't craft them. In this mod, the gems are distributed randomly among players. Each player receives one specific gem, turning every person on the server into a unique "class" with their own strengths and weaknesses.

# Core Features
Elemental Classes: 9 different gems including Earth, Air, Ice, Fire, Lucky, Warden, Electric, Minion, and Ender.

Unique Mechanics: Every gem features a Passive ability that is always active, plus active abilities triggered by Right-Click and Sneak + Right-Click.

Multiplayer Focused: Perfect for PvP, team wars, or cooperative survival where everyone brings a different skill to the table.

Modern Version: Built specifically for NeoForge 1.21.8.

# The Abilities
What can these gems actually do? From controlling the weather to summoning loyal companions or bending space and time... Check the abilities yourself, I’m not gonna spoil them! ## Technical Details

Platform: NeoForge

Minecraft Version: 1.21.8

Requirement: Designed for Multiplayer (can be used in Singleplayer, but the random distribution shines in a group!)



Gonna add more gems in future so stay tuned.
